title: oxalis quadriglandula
intro: Oxalis quadriglandula, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species in the Oxalidaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis quadriglandula are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
